rows.behavior: kmctl new doc TYPE TITLE creates the page in docs/TYPE/ with its title and that type's skeleton, for each of the four Diataxis types.
rows.fails_when: for any type the page is missing, is in the wrong folder, or lacks the title or skeleton headings

rows.behavior: The new page is added to docs/README.md and kmctl check passes afterwards.
rows.fails_when: docs/README.md has no entry linking the page, or kmctl check exits nonzero

rows.behavior: It refuses when docs/README.md is missing and names kmctl init.
rows.fails_when: it writes anything, exits 0, or the message does not name kmctl init

rows.behavior: It never overwrites an existing page.
rows.fails_when: an existing page's content changes, or the command exits 0
